subject: literacy
concept: Using a dictionary or glossary effectively to confirm a word's meaning and part of speech
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student locates a word in a simplified dictionary structure and identifies its definition and part of speech
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a dictionary entry to the sentence that correctly uses that word's meaning
exercise.abstract: Student looks up an unfamiliar word and correctly uses it in a new sentence

misconception_flags: picks the wrong definition when a word has multiple meanings, not matching context

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
